content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am looking for guidance on how to set a password in [product_name] so that operators are unable to modify parameters while the system is in RUN mode.

From what I know, there is currently no password protection available for preventing changes to parameters shown in message text. Clarification: Are you referring to the settings within the [product_name] programming menu, specifically the parameterization option?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are searching for a way to add password security to prevent operators from modifying parameters in [product_name], but they find the product does not support password protection for changes in RUN mode. This reveals a lack of security options for limiting unauthorized parameter modifications.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect there to be a function for password-protecting parameter changes during RUN mode, so only authorized personnel can perform these modifications.
